answer: To resist Sybil attacks, each consensus bridge requires nodes to pass identity registration through an entry inlet where they must lock and burn stake. Registration burns scale with a superlinear penalty: total cost for $n$ identities is $\sum_{i=1}^n i^2 \cdot \text{base}$, creating quadratic friction. Any verified behavioral delta triggers cryptographic stake slashing, forcing exponential cost scaling onto attackers attempting mass replication.
